remarks: Welcome to the expansive Chester model unit in the prestigious, gated community of Palmer Hill Homes, an award-winning development conveniently located at the border of Old Greenwich and Stamford. This bright and inviting home features 3 bedrooms, including a luxurious first-floor primary suite, and 3.1 bathrooms. Upon entering, you are greeted by double-height ceilings and beautiful hardwood floors that flow throughout the open floor plan. The gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream, equipped with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a gas fireplace, making it perfect for both entertaining and everyday living. The first-floor primary bedroom exudes a tranquil retreat with an elegant en-suite bathroom. Upstairs, you'll find two additional large bedrooms and a versatile den. This unit also includes a 2-car garage and is ideally situated close to the clubhouse, where you can enjoy a range of amenities, including a heated pool, hot tub, party room, fire pit, business room, and a state-of-the-art gym. Don't miss this opportunity to live in one of the most sought-after communities in the area.
